prompt:
Extract one invoice from the user text. Return only one JSON object with exactly these keys and string or JSON null values:
- vendor: issuer/seller/payee's full legal name as written, suffix included; never the bill-to customer.
- invoice_number: invoice identifier exactly as written, minus label; not PO, order, or customer ID.
- issue_date: invoice date, not delivery or order date.
- due_date: stated payment deadline date only.
- currency: billing code EUR, SEK, USD, GBP, CHF, NOK, or DKK (€→EUR, £→GBP, $→USD, kr→SEK); ignore informational conversions and their amounts.
- net: stated post-discount taxable amount excluding VAT, not the pre-discount subtotal; use a line amount only if labeled as invoice net.
- vat: stated VAT/sales-tax amount, not rate.
- total: stated gross amount payable, including tax.

English / Swedish / German labels may be broken across lines or contain OCR typos; values are intact. Useful anchors: Fakturanummer / Rechnungsnummer, Fakturadatum / Rechnungsdatum, Förfallodatum / Fällig am / Zahlbar bis, Netto / Nettobetrag, Moms / MwSt., Att betala / Gesamtbetrag.

Use null for unstated values, never guesses or calculations (including due dates from terms, net from other totals, and VAT from rates). Dates: YYYY-MM-DD; retain ISO year-first order, otherwise read numeric dates day-first even when ambiguous; expand YY to 20YY and recognize written months and ordinal days. Amounts: plain decimal strings, dot plus exactly two decimals; use the final comma or dot before the two fractional digits as the decimal mark, dropping grouping marks/spaces and currency. No extra keys, prose, or fences.
